ModMetaData.name: SloppyMod Trash POWER!
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Burn the trashbricks from Vanilla Recycling Expanded for power.
Adds two trashbrick stoves: a cobbled pellet stove and a cleaner, twice-as-efficient gasifier. Feed them by hand or from a hopper on their intake.
Advanced play mode (default): the stoves are burners making 250, 350 or 500W of heat. Pipe them to a steam turbine - a jerry-rigged 750W one early on, a 1500W one later - and on their own they make only 100-300W. Large (3x4) cobbled and gasifier burners make 750-1500W of heat, and an industrial (3x6) gasifier up to 3000W; they have no engine of their own and need turbines. Simple play mode: the stoves are self-contained 1000W and 1200W generators.
With Dubs Bad Hygiene: fecal sludge pellets as a second fuel, and a plumbing connection. Stoves heat the plumbing's hot water with whatever the turbines don't use. With Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory: belt-fed through factory hoppers.
Needs Vanilla Recycling Expanded, and is researched after complex recycling.
